name: premiere-editor-assistant
description: A local Premiere Pro workflow for project organization, usable Takes, complete Selects, native transcripts and OMF sound handoff.

interface.longDescription: Organize Project-panel bins and media display names using a numbered folder schema. Prepare editable, script-aware Takes and Selects with proxy playback, main-voice transcription imported into Premiere, shared part colors and verified edit recovery. Keep native transcripts ready for later caption creation. Export OMF sound handoffs from separate audio-only copies. Local macOS workflow with guided Premiere bridge setup.
defaultPrompt: Set up Premiere Editor Assistant on this Mac.
Create Takes and Selects from my Premiere sequence and storyboard.
Export an OMF sound handoff from my Premiere sequence.
